```
def run(nodes, adj, total):
    idx = [-1]*total
    low = [0]*total
    on = [False]*total
    stk = []
    comps = []
    counter = 0
    for root in nodes:
        if idx[root]!=-1: continue
        work = [(root, 0)]
        while work:
            v, pi = work[-1]
            if pi == 0:
                idx[v]=counter; low[v]=counter; counter+=1
                stk.append(v); on[v]=True
            recurse = False
            av = adj[v]
            while pi < len(av):
                w = av[pi]; pi += 1
                if idx[w]==-1:
                    work[-1]=(v,pi)
                    work.append((w,0)); recurse=True; break
                elif on[w]:
                    if idx[w]<low[v]: low[v]=idx[w]
            if recurse: continue
            work.pop()
            if low[v]==idx[v]:
                comp=[]
                while True:
                    w=stk.pop(); on[w]=False; comp.append(w)
                    if w==v: break
                comps.append(comp)
            if work:
                u=work[-1][0]
                if low[v]<low[u]: low[u]=low[v]
```
